context: A doctor explains a teen patient's symptoms at a check-up
purpose: Teach: 丼/宴会/唇/食物/爪/昨晩/汚い/症候群

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: さくらさん、昨晩はよく眠れましたか？顔色があまり良くないですね。
lines.en: Sakura, did you sleep well last night? Your complexion doesn't look very good.
lines.style: Calm professional doctor tone, gentle but probing concern.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実は学校の宴会みたいな打ち上げがあって、夜中まで起きてました。
lines.en: Actually there was a party-like gathering at school, and I stayed up until midnight.
lines.style: Slightly embarrassed teen voice, casual and apologetic tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: なるほど。唇が少し乾いていますね。水分は足りていますか？
lines.en: I see. Your lips look a bit dry. Are you getting enough fluids?
lines.style: Observant clinical voice, soft and methodical examination tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あんまり飲んでないかも。お昼は牛丼だけで済ませちゃいました。
lines.en: Maybe not really. For lunch I just had a beef bowl and called it done.
lines.style: Sheepish teenage admission, casual shrugging vocal quality.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: それはいけません。食物のバランスが崩れると、疲労症候群のような症状が出やすくなります。
lines.en: That won't do. When your food balance breaks down, fatigue-syndrome-like symptoms appear easily.
lines.style: Slightly firmer educational tone, doctor delivering important advice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ、それで爪も最近すごく割れやすいんです。関係ありますか？
lines.en: Oh, that's why my nails have been breaking really easily lately. Is it related?
lines.style: Curious teen realization, voice lifting with sudden understanding.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 大いに関係ありますよ。それと、手はちゃんと洗っていますか？汚い手で目をこすると感染症の原因になります。
lines.en: Very much related. Also, are you washing your hands properly? Rubbing your eyes with dirty hands causes infections.
lines.style: Warm but instructive parental-doctor cadence, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 気をつけます。今日からちゃんと食べて、早く寝るようにします。
lines.en: I'll be careful. Starting today I'll eat properly and try to sleep early.
lines.style: Resolved teenage promise, voice slightly more mature and earnest.
